# @boostengine/seo — Full AI Agent Manifest

## Overview
Zero-dependency TypeScript library for eCommerce SEO. Schema.org v24+ JSON-LD, Google Merchant XML feeds, Next.js metadata, sitemaps, robots.txt, SEO audits, AI function-calling tools, and React hooks.

## Package Exports
```json
{
  ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" },
  "./react": { "import": "./dist/react/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/react/index.cjs", "types": "./dist/react/index.d.ts" },
  "./ai": { "import": "./dist/ai/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/ai/index.cjs", "types": "./dist/ai/index.d.ts" }
}
```

## Core Types
- `SEOProduct` — Product with id, title, description, url, images, price, currency, availability, sku, gtin, mpn, brand, category, googleProductCategory, condition, weight, color, size, material, rating, reviews, returnPolicy, shippingDetails
- `BreadcrumbItem` — name, url
- `OrganizationConfig` — name, url, logo, description, contactPoint, sameAs, address
- `LocalBusinessConfig` — extends OrganizationConfig, priceRange, openingHours, servesCuisine
- `FAQItem` — question, answer
- `HowToStep` — name, text, image, url
- `ArticleItem` — headline, description, url, image, datePublished, dateModified, authorName, authorUrl, publisherName, publisherLogo
- `SitemapEntry` — loc, lastmod, changefreq, priority, images
- `NextMetadataOptions` — siteName, twitterHandle, locale, titleTemplate, description, alternates, robots
- `SEOAuditResult` — score 0-100, title/description/h1/openGraph/canonical checks, recommendations
- `FeedStoreInfo` — title, link, description
- `ShippingRate` — price, currency, free, freeOver
## Functions (from `@boostengine/seo`)
- `generateProductJsonLd(product)` → Full Product schema with Offer, AggregateRating, Review, MerchantReturnPolicy, ShippingDetails
- `generateBreadcrumbJsonLd(items)` → BreadcrumbList schema
- `generateFaqJsonLd(faqs)` → FAQPage schema
- `generateHowToJsonLd(name, desc, steps, totalTime?)` → HowTo schema
- `generateArticleJsonLd(article)` → Article schema
- `generateOrganizationJsonLd(org)` → Organization schema
- `generateLocalBusinessJsonLd(biz)` → LocalBusiness schema
- `generateItemListJsonLd(items, listType?)` → ItemList schema
- `toScriptTag(schema)` → HTML script tag string
- `JsonLdGenerator` → Class wrapping all schema functions (backward compat)
- `generateMerchantFeed(store, products)` → Google Merchant RSS 2.0 XML
- `generateMetaCatalogCsv(products)` → Facebook product CSV
- `ProductFeedGenerator` → Class wrapping feed functions
- `generateSitemapXml(entries)` → XML sitemap with image extensions
- `generateRobotsTxt(options)` → robots.txt content
- `SitemapGenerator` → Class wrapping sitemap functions
- `generateNextMetadata(product, options?)` → Next.js Metadata object
- `NextSeoHelper` → Class wrapping metadata function
- `auditPageSEO(input)` → SEO audit with score 0-100

## AI Tools (from `@boostengine/seo/ai`)
- `generate_jsonld_schema` — Generate any Schema.org JSON-LD
- `generate_merchant_feed` — Google Merchant XML feed
- `optimize_meta_tags` — High-CTR title & description
- `generate_sitemap_xml` — XML sitemaps
- `audit_page_seo` — SEO audit with score & recommendations
- `allAITools` — Array of all 5 tools
- `findTool(name)` — Find tool by name
- `executeToolCall(name, args)` — Execute a tool
- `toOpenAIFunctions()` — Convert to OpenAI format
- `toAnthropicTools()` — Convert to Anthropic format

## React (from `@boostengine/seo/react`)
- `<SEOProvider value={...}>{children}</SEOProvider>` — SEO context
- `useSEO()` — Access SEO config
- `<JsonLdScript schema={...} id?="..." />` — JSON-LD script tag
- `useProductJsonLd(product)` — Reactive Product JSON-LD
- `useBreadcrumbJsonLd(items)` — Reactive BreadcrumbList JSON-LD
- `useMetaTags(meta)` — Client-side head meta updater

## CLI
```
npx @boostengine/seo demo
npx @boostengine/seo audit --url <url>
npx @boostengine/seo generate-jsonld --type <type>
npx @boostengine/seo merchant-feed --input <file>
```
